answers.core: I think the current behaviour is confusing to the user and having a simplified flow would both reduce implementation complexity in the engine and make the feature easier to use, so it's a win-win having this in core.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around, one can choose to solely use the "Custom" flow and build the custom matrix compose nodes themselves using the extension point to build custom nodes.

title: Remove custom/non-custom variants in visual particle shaders
